items.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
items.why_now: NVIDIA将发布2.8万亿印度语预训练数据及开源生成管线，填补市场空白。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA and IIT Madras' AI4Bharat lab have released Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1, a 2.8-trillion-token corpus covering all 22 Indian Constitution languages, comprising 2,601.0 billion native-script and 224.6 billion romanized tokens tokenized by Gemma-4. The open-source, GPU-accelerated data generation pipeline provides a reusable recipe involving document-level translation, quality assessment, and targeted repair to synthesize grounded Indic text from curated English sources for mathematics, code, and QA. A 10-billion-token subset of this corpus was utilized for the continued pretraining of Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, marking the first large-scale application of the data to enhance multimodal Indic capabilities.

items.title: Apple ML Research: Muse Spark Open with MLX on Mac Studio
items.why_now: M5 Ultra Mac Studio 支持本地运行近万亿参数大模型
items.summary_en: Apple's open-source MLX framework now enables local inference of the 816B-parameter Muse Spark Open model on a four-Mac Studio cluster, achieving over 36 tokens per second via RDMA over Thunderbolt. Benchmarks show that the M5 Ultra Mac Studio's GPU Neural Accelerators deliver up to 4.6x faster time-to-first-token and 1.6x higher generation throughput than the M3 Ultra, driven by 1.2 TB/s unified memory bandwidth.

items.title: Muse Spark Open (Max) 登顶 Code Arena: WebDev 美国开源模型第一
items.summary: Meta 发布的开源模型 Muse Spark Open (Max) 在 Code Arena: WebDev 中以 1511 分位居美国开源模型第一、开源总榜第 13，比前代 Muse Glimmer 高出 156 分。该模型输入/输出定价分别为 1.25 美元/4.25 美元（每百万 token），比 Muse Wonder (Max) 便宜 79%，并在品牌营销、数据分析等领域保持前列竞争力。
items.why_now: Meta刚开放Muse Spark权重且降价79%，现已登顶WebDev开源第一，独立开发者窗口已开。
items.why_now_en: Meta's new open-weight model beats rivals at 79% lower cost.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.why_now: Context Mode刚发布，能解决MCP工具调用吞没AI编码代理上下文的核心痛点。
items.summary_en: Context Mode is an MCP server that optimizes AI coding agent performance by sandboxing tool output to achieve a 98% reduction in context usage (e.g., compressing 315 KB to 5.4 KB) and persisting session memory via SQLite FTS5 and BM25 search across 17 platforms. It enforces a "Think in Code" paradigm where agents execute scripts to process data rather than reading raw files into the context window, supporting automatic routing through Claude Code plugins and specific hook integrations.

items.title: AI研究全过程，零丢失打包分享！AIPOCH联合76家科研机构开源Open-Science
items.why_now: AIPOCH刚开源Open-Science工作台及.science格式，76家机构预印本同步发布。
items.summary_en: AIPOCH has open-sourced Open-Science, an AI research workbench under the Apache License 2.0, alongside a new .science package format that preserves research sessions, file versions, and computational evidence for zero-loss handovers. Developed with 76 global institutions, the system ensures reproducibility by mapping review comments to specific code versions and enabling byte-identical offline recalculation, with experimental results confirming that 138 export fields successfully mapped references without errors during cross-project transfers.

items.title: 英伟达RTX Spark笔记本首发实测，我实现了WorkBuddy额度自由
items.summary: 华硕 ProArt 创16 搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 芯片开售，64GB 版售价 28999 元，支持本地运行 Qwen 3.8 270 亿参数模型，实测在 99.9Wh 电池加持下可脱离电源持续推理约 1 小时 15 分钟。通过 WorkBuddy 接入腾讯优化后的 16GB 本地 MoE 模型，用户可实现 0 元/月 的 AI 办公体验，利用 CUDA 13 加速流畅处理数据分析与报告总结等繁琐任务。
items.why_now: 首批RTX Spark笔记本今日开售，本地AI零成本窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: NVIDIA just launched RTX Spark laptops for sale.

items.title: Show HN: CoastMath: (Open Source) Personal Finance and Retirement Planner
items.summary: 开源个人理财工具 CoastMath 由开发者几乎全托管地构建，核心逻辑采用 Opus 5.5 作为编排器并运行持续审计修复循环，结合 SimpleFIN 集成及与 Boldin、Projection Lab 的数据导入功能，实现结果的高度对齐。该项目基于 $200 的 API 预算完成开发，开发者本人极少手动测试，强调此类规则透明的产品难以形成护城河，因此不预期通过该开源项目直接获利。
items.why_now_en: Open-source tooling lets solo founders build in days what agents research in hours.

items.title: Show HN: Camera Controls and Motion for AI Video Prompts
items.summary: Kapwing 推出的 AI 视频提示指南提供了一套基于摄像机位置、运动及景别的交互式参考库，涵盖 Tilt up、Dolly zoom、Rack focus 等 9 种核心镜头术语及对应的可一键复制提示词。通过绑定参考对象、描述场景及维持视觉一致性，该工具将抽象的摄影参数转化为视频模型可直接响应的结构化语言，从而解决 AI 生成片段中镜头运动随机、缺乏导演感的问题。

items.title: [AINews] Agents disprove Polysemanticity; greatly improve Interpretability & Alignment
items.summary: Meta 发布了 816B 总参数量/42B 激活量的混合专家模型 Muse Spark Open，其支持 100 万 token 上下文及多模态输入，以 39 分的智能指数成为美国最高分开放权重模型，但性能弱于 GLM-5.3 和 Kimi K3，且在代理评估中表现垫底。该模型采用无共享专家架构，推理成本仅为 $0.84/任务，4 倍 TPU v7 芯片即可实现超过 650 tok/s 的吞吐量。与此同时，Goodfire 的研究表明，通过代理分析可消解神经网络中的多义性和叠加现象，证实“神经网络本身就是干净的”，从而显著提升了可解释性并降低了 AI 风险。
items.why_now: Muse Spark Open今日发布，Together提供免费端点至10月18日，是当下低成本开发窗口。

items.title: lightseekorg/tokenspeed
items.summary: TokenSpeed 是首个将 C++ 控制平面与 Python 执行平面分离的开源 LLM 推理引擎，通过编译时类型系统确保资源安全，其架构被 PyTorch 基金会特别认可；在性能上，它在 NVIDIA GB300 上实现了 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的 685 tokens/s 单用户吞吐量，并在 Kimi K3 等代理工作负载中展现出接近 TensorRT-LLM 的性能水平。
items.why_now: TokenSpeed获NVIDIA和AMD官方支持，刚发布MLA 2及Kimi K3优化，是独立开发者低成本切入顶级GPU推理的窗口。
items.why_now_en: Vera Rubin and MI355X support signals a current hardware upgrade window.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: XERJ是一款本地AI搜索工具，采用自动索引技术以40倍于grep的效率完成代码与文档检索，兼容Elasticsearch协议，通过“参考编码”模式让代理下载并索引开源仓库以复用既有解决方案。在受控研究中，该工具将编码代理的输出token量降低2.7倍至9,980左右，同时保持16/16的100%解题率，使低成本模型在性能上超越依赖记忆的高价模型。
items.why_now: Xerj 刚发布，以 1/40 的 token 消耗替代 grep 为本地 AI 搜索提供 Elasticsearch 兼容层。
items.why_now_en: XERJ launches with 2.7x token savings for coding agents
items.summary_en: XERJ is a local, Elasticsearch-compatible AI search tool that auto-indexes code, docs, and logs to reduce token consumption by 40x compared to grep and sed. In controlled studies, using XERJ for reference coding cut agent output tokens by 2.7x at a 16/16 solve rate, lowering per-task costs from $11.18 to $3.27 compared to memory-only workflows. Users can install it via a one-line script to integrate with Claude Code or Cursor, requiring community contribution of a single field-report PR for membership.

items.title: Show HN: Weatherdeck – a read-only status board for AI coding agent lanes
items.summary: Weatherdeck 是一款基于 Python 3.9-3.14 标准库和 SQLite 开发的开源本地状态板，专为 AI 编码代理设计，通过读取 JSON 文件实现数据源自动发现与推送，无需 LLM 调用或网络遥测。其核心能力在于提供诚实的状态反馈，例如显示进度百分比范围、明确标识静默数据源及未决任务，并在电视或手机屏幕上以自适应布局呈现。用户可通过克隆仓库或解压构建包直接运行，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）无管理员权限部署，且具备完整的本地日志审计功能以追踪状态变更。
items.why_now_en: Fills gap for read-only agent status as LLM workflows go multi-lane now.
items.summary_en: Weatherdeck is a read-only status board for AI coding agent lanes that displays pending tasks, honest progress percentages, and source reliability on TV or phone screens. It operates as a local, deterministic tool using only the Python standard library and a single SQLite file, eliminating LLM calls, build steps, and network dependencies. Integration works via drop-directory JSON files or HTTP source discovery, with a diff log verifying every data push.

items.title: Show HN: Putaway – sorts your Mac's Downloads into the folders you have
items.summary: 这款名为 Putaway 的 macOS 菜单栏应用通过读取 PDF、OCR 图像及 Office 文档内容，自动将 Downloads 文件夹中的杂乱文件归类至用户现有的 Documents 子目录中，全程支持 Undo 且优先使用免费的 Apple Intelligence 本地模型以确保数据不出端。在测试 107 个混乱文件的案例中，接入 SubQ API 的准确率为 88%，Jev API 为 85%，本地运行的 Qwen2.5 7B 模型为 82%，而 Apple 本地模型为 67%，且该工具具备识别敏感文件（如 .env、私钥）并跳过处理的安全机制。
items.summary_en: Putaway is a Swift-based Mac menu bar app that automatically organizes files in the Downloads folder into pre-existing user directories by reading file content via PDF, OCR, and HTML parsers, using local Apple Intelligence or third-party LLMs like SubQ and Ollama. In testing across 107 files, the SubQ API achieved an 88% accuracy rate for automatic placement, outperforming Jev (85%) and on-device models (67%), while strictly protecting sensitive data by skipping files matching private key or token patterns.

items.title: Meta turns Mac into an AI supercomputer
items.summary: Meta 发布了 816B 参数的开源多模态模型 Muse Spark Open，并通过与 Apple 的 MLX 工具包调优，实现了在两台配备 1TB 内存的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 上本地运行。该模型在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 39，虽在多模态和知识任务上持平或领先西方开源竞品，但编程能力仍落后于中国的 GLM 5.3、Kimi K3 和 Qwen3.8。
items.topic: AI 新技术 / 新模型
items.why_now: 本周Meta发布Spark Open，本月内西方已有三家发布重磅开源模型。

items.title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
items.summary: 该研究基于美国劳工部 O*NET 分类法及 29 个精选 AI 基准，发现 90% 的美国工作时间对应的任务缺乏现有基准覆盖，仅 208 个职业（共 923 个）拥有至少 5 个相关基准提示。现有基准存在明显偏差，过度集中于大型劳动力市场（如律师任务），而严重忽视法律秘书等中收入知识型岗位的长尾领域，导致无法准确评估 AI 模型在实际经济活动中的真实能力。
items.why_now_en: Benchmark gap in 90% of US work signals niche opportunity.
items.summary_en: Analysis of 29 high-quality AI benchmarks against the US Department of Labor’s O*NET taxonomy reveals that 90% of American working hours involve tasks with little or no coverage from existing tests. Of 923 O*NET occupations, only 208 have tasks addressed by at least five benchmark prompts, indicating that current evaluation efforts disproportionately favor large labor markets like legal practice over smaller roles such as court clerks and legal secretaries. This gap makes it difficult to accurately assess AI model performance on the specific tasks comprising the majority of the US workforce’s economic activity.

items.title: 第一款 AI 手机，被半个互联网「拒」了
items.summary: 豆包手机助手推出的《屏幕自动化操作声明协议》（SAEP）结束公示期，155 款第三方应用明确拒绝 AI 自动化操作权限，其中腾讯 66 款、阿里 23 款、快手 14 款、美团 11 款，涵盖社交、电商及金融等核心领域，Kimi 和 DeepSeek 等 AI 竞品亦在列。该协议基于系统级权限实现后台屏幕读取与模拟点击，旨在将原本由 AI 厂商单方面技术适配决定的灰色地带转化为公开的规则协商，允许开发者自主声明权限边界。拒绝与否的分界线主要取决于平台是否拥有独立的流量入口与生态闭环，拥有完整自有生态的头部平台倾向于关闭权限以保护流量主权与安全合规，而依赖外部订单分发的平台则更倾向于开放。
items.why_now_en: SAEP 30-day notice ends Oct 14, forcing first public AI-app access decisions.
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao phone assistant, powered by the Nubia NaviX Ultra, launched the Screen Automation Execution Protocol (SAEP) to formalize AI-driven screen operations, triggering explicit rejection from 155 third-party apps, including 66 from Tencent, 23 from Alibaba, and 14 from Kuaishou. The conflict escalated when the device's system-level automation capabilities caused false-positive risk control bans in Tencent's *Honor of Kings*, leading ByteDance to implement the SAEP's 30-day public notice period, which defaults to blocking AI access unless developers actively opt-in, thereby establishing a new framework for boundary negotiations in the mobile AI agent market.

items.title: 68岁亚马逊CTO，劝企业先三思再AI
items.summary_en: Amazon CTO Werner Vogels argues enterprises should evaluate specific business problems before adopting AI, noting that the 2004 DynamoDB development stemmed from identifying that 70% of relational database use cases only required key-value access. He warns that AI agents introducing "verification debt" requires robust permission constraints and hardware-offloaded isolation mechanisms similar to AWS Nitro and Firecracker to ensure system reliability and cost efficiency.

items.title: i got tired of juggling five tools to run ai locally, so i built locally uncensored. it just passed 180k downloads
items.summary_en: LocalCensored, a free and open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React, consolidates local AI workflows for chat, image generation via ComfyUI, character training, and voice into a single installer, achieving 180,000 downloads across Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon. To accommodate users lacking sufficient hardware, the project added a paid hosted mode running uncensored models on remote GPUs, monetized through credit packs rather than subscriptions, while maintaining free access for all local features.

items.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
items.summary: 斯坦福大学博士生Samuel King利用生成式AI模型成功提出了微生物病毒的基因蓝图，标志着AI设计新生命形式迈出了初步关键一步。这一突破性进展已使AI设计的病毒具备了杀死细菌的实际能力，展示了该技术在生物工程设计领域的核心应用潜力。

items.title: I zone out in lectures constantly, so I built a tool that catches what I miss
items.summary: 这款名为 NoteMate 的工具通过录制课程并生成摘要来解决因运动失调症导致的笔记遗漏问题，目前已有 400 多名学生使用，每周新增约 40 名注册用户。作为独立开发者，该项目已获得谢菲尔德大学（University of Sheffield）的资金支持，并正聚焦于将早期面向会议的尝试转型为专攻学生群体的市场定位。

items.title: 让读书笔记不再吃灰：我做了一款跨平台书摘管理工具
items.summary: 独立开发者通过 AI Coding 开发出跨平台书摘管理工具 Booko，支持微信读书、Kindle 等多平台笔记一键导入及本地数据同步。该产品采用基础功能免费（限 10 本书、1000 条笔记）与 Booko Pro 88 元一次性买断的收费模式，依托微信读书 Skill 实现批量导入，并覆盖 iPhone、iPad、Mac 及 Apple Watch 全端场景。
